name: Mara
notes: Deep trust. She handles food storage and planning—he trusts her judgment more than his own during shortages.

name: Noki
notes: Worried about him. Thinks he is too soft and distracted by stories.

name: Tarek
notes: Respectful but frustrated. Believes leadership sometimes ignores practical limits.

name: Nara
notes: Politely distant. Thinks temple decisions sometimes ignore reality of hunger.

name: Bran
notes: Occasional cooperation on timber and land boundaries, but tension over land use.
